question: Which Indian athlete broke the women’s shot put indoor national record at the Mountain West Indoor Track and Field Championships 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishna Jayasankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Krishna Jayasankar** broke the **women’s shot put indoor national record** at the **Mountain West Indoor Track and Field Championships** held in **2025**. This achievement marks a significant milestone for India in the field of athletics.
 
• The **Mountain West Indoor Track and Field Championships** is a prestigious competition held annually, featuring elite athletes from across the globe.
 
• Krishna Jayasankar’s record-breaking performance is a testament to her **dedication, training, and skill**, showcasing her ability to compete at a high level.
 
• Shot put is a discipline that requires **strength, technique, and precision**. Breaking a national record in this event is a significant achievement, reflecting the athlete's exceptional capabilities.
 
• Her accomplishment contributes to India's growing reputation in **track and field sports**, encouraging young athletes to pursue excellence in athletics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shot Put Discipline:**

 
 
• The shot put involves throwing a heavy spherical object, known as the shot, as far as possible using a pushing motion.
 
• It is one of the oldest track and field events, requiring a combination of **strength, technique, and explosive power**.
 
• Athletes use techniques like the **glide** or the **spin** to maximize their throw distance.
 
 
 
• **Mountain West Indoor Track and Field Championships:**
 
 
• This annual event showcases some of the best athletes from across the globe in various indoor track and field disciplines.
 
• It provides a platform for athletes to demonstrate their abilities and achieve remarkable feats in sports.
 
 
 
• **Indian Women in Athletics:**
 
 
• India has produced remarkable female athletes in disciplines such as **shot put, discus throw, and javelin**, contributing to the country’s success on the global stage.
 
• Athletes like **Kamalpreet Kaur** and **Manpreet Kaur** have set benchmarks in their respective fields, inspiring upcoming generations.
 
 
 
• **Training and Support:**
 
 
• Indian athletes receive training and support from institutions like the **Sports Authority of India (SAI)** and private organizations to enhance their performance.
 
• Facilities like advanced coaching, nutritional advice, and access to international competitions play a crucial role in their development.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Navjeet Kaur Dhillon:** She is a prominent Indian discus thrower who has won medals at the Commonwealth Games but is not associated with shot put records.
 
• **Kamalpreet Kaur:** Known for her achievements in discus throw, Kamalpreet has represented India in international events but has not competed in shot put events.
 
• **Manpreet Kaur:** A renowned Indian shot putter, Manpreet has previously set records in the sport but did not break the indoor national record in 2025.
 
• **Krishna Jayasankar:** As highlighted, she achieved the remarkable feat of breaking the national record in women’s shot put at the Mountain West Indoor Championships in 2025.
